race.name: Huffmaster Grasshopper
race.tagline: Ninety mixed-terrain miles where wind, mud, and the back-half climbs decide the race.

vitals.field_size: Several hundred riders; exact 2026 count not published
vitals.registration: 2027 registration is open through the organizer's Movemint link; the event page still carries 2026 deadline details
vitals.prize_purse: Cash prizes for top five pro men and women in 2026

logistics.explanation: Maxwell sits directly off Interstate 5 and the race starts at the high school, making access unusually simple for a rural gravel event.

length.explanation: The 90-mile long course sits squarely in the all-day endurance category without becoming an ultra.

technicality.explanation: Across 46% dirt, most of the difficulty comes from fast loose descending, mud, and pack compression at pinch points rather than continuous singletrack.

elevation.explanation: The 4,866 feet are back-loaded, with the decisive gravel climb near mile 40 and additional climbing after the field has already covered hours of flat road.

climate.explanation: Documented editions have combined headwinds, cold rain, mud, and even snow, making February conditions a defining variable rather than background noise.

altitude.explanation: The main climb tops near 1,700 feet, so altitude does not materially limit performance.

adventure.explanation: Remote roads between the Sacramento Valley and Mendocino National Forest create real isolation, though the route remains a road-and-gravel race rather than an expedition.

prestige.explanation: Huffmaster is an established Grasshopper fixture with repeated national cycling coverage and recognizable winners.

race_quality.explanation: Chip timing, emergency medical support, aid stations, event photography, cash prizes, and a full finish meal support a mature race operation.

experience.explanation: The remote back half and tactical surface changes are memorable, but the long flat approach makes the experience more race-specific than scenic-tour spectacular.

community.explanation: Grasshopper combines serious racing with coffee, lunch, a finish party, junior fields, teams, and a long-standing NorCal scene.

field_depth.explanation: The 2026 race included former US gravel champion Brennan Wertz and other national-level athletes, with both elite races decided in close sprints.

value.explanation: Support and inclusions are strong, but the completed event page no longer exposes a reliable entry price for comparison.

expenses.explanation: A drive-to race in a small Interstate 5 town can be done with ordinary lodging and food costs.

cultural_impact.explanation: Huffmaster has a durable identity inside the NorCal mixed-terrain calendar and earns national media attention beyond a typical regional gravel race.

course_description.character: A tactical 54-percent paved, 46-percent dirt loop whose mostly flat first 25 miles give way to a climbing and descending contest in the remote back half.
course_description.signature_challenge: The punchy gravel climb from roughly mile 40 to 43 breaks the large front group, then a fast dirt descent and later Huffmaster Ranch climb punish anyone who spent too much in the valley wind.

suffering_zones.label: Valley headwind
suffering_zones.description: The first 25 paved miles can become expensive when wind turns an apparently easy start into a positioning fight.

suffering_zones.label: County Road 303 climb
suffering_zones.description: The course narrows and kicks upward near mile 40, historically splitting the main field into small groups.

suffering_zones.label: Huffmaster Ranch and return
suffering_zones.description: A late climb followed by a long downhill drag rewards riders who can still work with a group after three or more hours.

terrain.surface: 54% paved and 46% dirt on the official 2026 long course

climate.description: February weather can range from dry and fast to cold mud, snow, and persistent headwind.

logistics.getting_there: Maxwell is along Interstate 5; 2026 packet pickup and the start were based at Maxwell High School.
logistics.accommodation: Lodging is limited in Maxwell, so many riders will base in a larger nearby town.
logistics.parking: Organizer-designated school and town parking; follow the current rider guide when a new edition is announced.

history.overview: Huffmaster is a recurring mixed-terrain round of the Grasshopper Adventure Series.
notable_moments: The 2023 edition became a mud-and-snow survival race with heavy attrition.
Brennan Wertz won the 2026 men's race in a course-record 3:50:02; Alia Shafi won the women's race.

final_verdict.one_liner: A deceptively tactical ninety-miler where the easy-looking road start merely delays the real bill.
final_verdict.who_is_it_for: Riders who can race efficiently in a group, climb hard after two hours, descend loose roads at speed, and adapt equipment to late-winter conditions.
final_verdict.is_it_worth_it: Yes. The organizer has confirmed the February 28, 2027 edition, and it has field depth, wind exposure, and mixed-terrain course character that most regional races cannot match.
pro_tips: Train long tempo in wind and learn to conserve energy inside a moving group.
Do not choose tires from the paved percentage alone; inspect the final mud report.
Practice a hard 10-15 minute climb after two hours of endurance work.
Fuel before the mile-40 split, not after it.
